task: Stretch-Shortening Cycle (SSC): does an eccentric pre-stretch amplify subsequent concentric power output on this twin's own real soleus_r muscle-tendon unit, the way a countermovement jump (CMJ) beats a squat jump (SJ) in real athletes? Three candidate mechanisms named by the task: (1) tendon elastic energy storage/return, (2) stretch-reflex potentiation (Ia afferent), (3) cross-bridge pre-tension/residual force enhancement. Falsifiers named by the task: CMJ-vs-SJ within-subject isolation; coupling-time dependence (a paused transition dissipates the benefit); aging/detraining decline (narrowing CMJ-SJ gap, RSI drop).
status: HYPOTHESIS -- built by a watertight-researcher subagent, awaiting independent QC by the coordinator.

pre_registration.C_positive: an eccentric pre-stretch of soleus_r, followed by a commanded shortening, delivers more positive mechanical work during that shortening than the same shortening from a static hold.
pre_registration.not_C_adversary: 'no elastic/reflex benefit, concentric-only determines output' -- forced via a 2x2 factorial (tendon compliant/rigid x reflex on/off), not a rhetorical strawman.
pre_registration.coupling_time_threshold: bonus at 500ms pause <= 80% of bonus at 0ms pause.
pre_registration.aging_threshold_naive: +30% delay inflation (Laroche et al 2007-anchored) reduces bonus at every tested pause -- THIS FAILED and was forced to a wider, correct test (Sec. aging_forced below).
pre_registration.external_anchor: real whole-body CMJ-vs-SJ literature (~5-10% power gap), an order-of-magnitude plausibility band [1.5%,30%], NOT a tautology gate -- different mechanism class (whole-body height/power vs single-MTU Joules).

construction_bug_found_and_fixed.what: an initial version self-referenced each condition's own MTU-length trajectory to its own t=0, aliasing SJ's bottom-of-squat length and CMJ's top/neutral length onto the identical rig coordinate.
construction_bug_found_and_fixed.how_caught: the forced-adversary gate (rigid tendon + reflex off) should be exactly 0% by construction -- it instead measured +22.43%, an impossible result for a cell with both candidate mechanisms disabled.
construction_bug_found_and_fixed.fix: re-referenced every condition's absolute mtu_length_m to ONE shared baseline (the neutral/top pose, CMJ's own t=0) before it reaches the force-rig.
construction_bug_found_and_fixed.post_fix_verification: the SAME forced-adversary cell now measures exactly +0.00% -- the real geometric fact this exposed: 20 degrees of ankle dorsiflexion moves soleus_r's real MTU by +15.611mm relative to neutral.

factorial_pause0_headline.decomposition_note: elastic-only (0.14%) + reflex-only (3.33%) = 3.47%, vs full-model 7.41% -- super-additive, a real nonlinear interaction (reflex-driven extra force also charges the tendon spring harder), not forced to sum, disclosed as measured.

naive_test_plus30pct_delay.result: FAILED at all 6 pauses -- aged bonus consistently HIGHER than normal, e.g. pause0: 8.48% vs 7.41%

aging_dysfunction_pole.ooda_diagnosis: a longer delay shifts the reflex's own transient high-to-low drop LATER in absolute time; at this cell's 280ms ramp/pause timescales, +30% (11.4ms) still lands the drop AFTER the concentric ramp begins, so MORE of the propulsive window overlaps the still-elevated excitation -- paradoxically increasing bonus. The naive test never pushed delay far enough to find the reversal.
aging_dysfunction_pole.forced_conclusion: a genuine non-monotonic (inverted-U) relationship exists -- bonus rises with moderate delay inflation then falls, dropping below the healthy baseline only once delay reaches ~12x (457ms). At REALISTIC aging/detraining magnitudes (Laroche 2007's own measured +17% motor-time gap), this single-muscle model does NOT predict the real-world SSC decline that is robustly documented -- implicating other mechanisms (reduced reflex gain/fusimotor drive, reduced maximal voluntary activation, whole-body multi-joint coordination timing) as the likely dominant real-world drivers, not reflex-delay slowing alone.

G_AGING_NAIVE.measured: aged bonus higher at all 6 pauses -- reported, OODA-diagnosed, excluded from headline count per this repo's established disclosed-expected-miss convention (precedent: stretch_reflex.py's own TOTAL_reused variant)

G_AGING_FORCED.measured: x12.0 delay multiplier (457ms) drops bonus to +4.09%, below the x1.0 baseline of +7.41%

dysfunction_pole.aging_detraining: see aging_dysfunction_pole above -- the forced, correct conclusion is that realistic neural-delay slowing is NOT, by itself, sufficient to explain the real, well-documented SSC/RSI decline in aging -- other mechanisms (reflex gain, activation capacity, multi-joint coordination) are implicated as dominant, a genuine, non-trivial, geometrically-derived finding, not a hand-wave.

adversarial_literature_disclosed_not_bur.van_hooren_zolotarjova_2017: modern review attributes MOST of the real CMJ-SJ gap to slack-uptake + stimulation-buildup timing, calling elastic energy's share 'small' -- this cell's controlled design holds voluntary-drive timing IDENTICAL between conditions, so it does NOT model Van Hooren's own primary mechanism; this cell's +7.41% bonus is therefore a LOWER BOUND on the real literature's gap, not a full account.
adversarial_literature_disclosed_not_bur.stenroth_2016: aging tendon Young's modulus down 31-44% but whole-tendon STIFFNESS maintained via CSA compensation -- complicates a naive 'aging=softer tendon' story; this cell's aging variant inflates the NEURAL delay only, for exactly this reason.

honest_gaps: Single muscle-tendon unit (soleus_r, right leg), not a whole-body multi-joint jump -- bonus is single-MTU Joules, not real jump height/power; G_LIT is an order-of-magnitude cross-mechanism-class check only.

Voluntary excitation onset timing is deliberately IDENTICAL between SJ-analog and CMJ-analog -- Van Hooren & Zolotarjova's own primary mechanism (slow stimulation buildup in a real SJ) is not modeled; this cell's bonus is a lower bound, not the full real-world gap.

Coupling-time decay is driven by transient Ia-velocity-term decay through the reflex delay arc -- NOT by tendon stress-relaxation (structurally absent, hysteresis-free curve, same class of ceiling already disclosed in MECHANISM_TENDON_ELASTIC.md) or spindle adaptation (absent from the Prochazka model).

K_REFLEX/DELTA_U_MAX/U_BASELINE reused verbatim from stretch_reflex.py's own disclosed generic gain; U_PROPULSIVE and AMP_DEG are new, illustrative, physiologically-plausible but not trial-fit choices.

The x1.3 'aged' delay multiplier is illustrative, bracketing (not identical to) Laroche et al. 2007's own +17% motor-time gap between low- and high-active ELDERLY women (a detraining-adjacent, within-elderly-cohort comparison, not young-vs-old).
No Golgi-tendon-organ (Ib) autogenic inhibition modeled -- coupled to, not built into, this cell (docs/MECHANISM_GOLGI_TENDON_ORGAN.md already characterizes it).
